answer: Reward regular cadence, not raw tenure. Standing is scored on the CONSISTENCY of participation — low variance in the gaps between an identity's contributions over a long window — so a steady orchard of epoch-by-epoch work accrues weight while bursty, toggled activity does not. A farmer waking a delta of dormant fakes in sudden waves leaves a jagged signature that scores near zero; holding a thousand identities at a genuine steady cadence is a fable no operator can afford, since each head must do real work every epoch to keep its rhythm.
